narr: On the evening of July 31st, a cluster of severe storms brought large hail, wind damage and heavy rainfall to portions of southeast Minnesota. In some areas, heavy rainfall totals led to flooding of various roads and low-lying areas in residential communities.
ev: Law enforcement reported water over highway 63 north of Zumbro Falls.
Trained spotters reported flooding of ditches near residences in Elgin.
lsr: Flash flooding of ditches near residences at 205 1st St NW, Elgin, MN 55932.
